Do not add decorative scenery, foliage, patterns, frames, props or panels. Keep quiet areas quiet. The result should look like the same game's best production build.

The largest quality leap will come later from animation, VFX and audio. This still image should be an exceptionally clear, faithful foundation for that motion, not a redesign. Preserve the exact frozen game state: every piece count, identity, color, order, occupied/empty cell, link, stack, symbol, number and visible word. Preserve functional hitbox footprints, board geometry, camera perspective, composition, tutorial cue, logos and disclosure text. Do not add/remove pieces or UI; do not invent a reward, victory or new mechanic. Keep original text verbatim. Return one full-bleed portrait screen at the input aspect ratio, no comparison panels, border or captions.


GAME-SPECIFIC LOCK: Preserve the simple 2D outlined kawaii cat faces, warm cream paw-pattern background and brick container. The source cats use simple soft fills; retain that restrained finish rather than adding sculpture, detailed fur, anime styling or new shadows. Preserve one suspended brown/white smiling cat and exactly four pile cats: white upper-left, brown/white upper-right under the glove, calico lower-left, black lower-right. Preserve 5000, RECEIVE, the original hand position, and the visible lower disclosure fragment. No drop, merge, new cat or reward in this still.
